title: Gear trains and fractions
body: A compound gear train is arranged from left to right. The leftmost driver gear (pink, $$14$$ teeth) meshes with the large gear of a central compound pair (blue, $$42$$ teeth). This blue gear is fixed to the same shaft as a smaller gear (yellow, $$14$$ teeth). The yellow gear meshes with the rightmost driven gear (orange, $$28$$ teeth).\n##figure5.gif
